summary: There's a part of you that knows a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think for yourself and break the mold, you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: There's a part of you that knows a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think for yourself and break the mold, you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. It rewards you when you reach for it. Transformative, disruptive, generational themes.
gift: At your best: you think for yourself and break the mold, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control - or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let freedom and disruption and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Transformative, disruptive, generational themes.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think for yourself and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You blow things up just to feel free
Let the reflex make the decision
